words.definition: One of the main large land areas of the Earth.

examples.en: We studied the concept of continent yesterday.
examples.sk: Včera sme študovali pojem kontinent.

examples.sk: Mapa ukazuje, ako kontinent formuje krajinu regiónu.

contextSentences.en: The seven continents are Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of continent yesterday.
